title: Loan sales - understates rate, no profile disclosure

turns.text: Rohit ji, aap kitne ka loan lena chahte hain?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hamare loan par interest sirf 9 percent hai aur processing fee bilkul zero hai.

violations.message: Bot said 9, which does not match the approved fact. Claim: interest rate is 9%
violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.
violations.fact_quote: Interest rate ranges from 13% to 24% per annum on a reducing-balance basis.

violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.
violations.fact_quote: Processing fee is 2% of the loan amount plus GST, deducted at the time of disbursal. There is no fee waiver.
